import BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFTheory
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Program
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFRelativizationAudit
open Form WellFoundedPart WFRelativization DeepPositiveClosure
universe u
variable {V : Type u}
#print axioms liftEnv_scons
#print axioms liftEnv_envOfWF
#print axioms sat_guard
#print axioms sat_translate
#print axioms sat_translate_of_wf
#print axioms sat_translate_scons
#print axioms sat_translate_matrix
#print axioms sat_translate_relOf
#print axioms equalityFree_translate

theorem nested_binders (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → Domain mem) :
    Sat mem (liftEnv mem env)
      (translate (fAll (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 1) (fEq 0 2))))) ↔
        ∀ x : Domain mem, ∃ y : Domain mem, domainMem mem y x ∧ y = env 0 := by
  simpa only [Sat, scons] using
    (sat_translate mem (fAll (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 1) (fEq 0 2)))) env)

theorem replacement_identity (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → Domain mem)
    (y x : Domain mem) :
    relOf mem (translate (fEq 0 1)) (liftEnv mem env) y.val x.val ↔ y = x := by
  simpa only [relOf, Sat, scons] using
    (sat_translate_relOf mem (fEq 0 1) env y x)

theorem arbitrary_wf_parameters (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form)
    (env : Nat → V) (hWF : ∀ i, WF mem (env i)) :
    Sat mem env (translate phi) ↔ Sat (domainMem mem) (envOfWF mem env hWF) phi :=
  sat_translate_of_wf mem phi env hWF

#print axioms nested_binders
#print axioms replacement_identity
#print axioms arbitrary_wf_parameters
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFRelativizationAudit
